author: nicolaswuffwuff
quote:
First time writing a review for a game and I was not expecting to write this too be honest. I was hoping for something that outdone GTA5, but no, it's chore simulator. What?... Why? I want to play the game how I see fit and all 'directional' choices the game developers added feel just 'in the way' of what could've been a great game. I'm sad to see I waisted my money on this. And all the 'critics' reviews? What happened there? Did they play the game even?

I'm about 7 hours in, but I'm loosing interest faster then I can write this review sad to say. Hopefully a new patch comes out soon enough so I can actually play the game as it was intended or how GTA5 feels like. That would turn this score in a massive win.

And before people think "hey, there's another woke hater", well... in this case, yeah. The game showcased you can do anything you like and then literally pulled the rug on 80% of freedom. Stick with GTA5 if you want to have a good time. Play the new game if you want to do grocery shopping simulater -.-
